transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been hearing voices at work, through the monitor speakers. During quiet times, even when all the channels are muted, I’ll hear things like, You missed it, Ruth, or that people are going to get hurt because of me. Nobody else hears them. It’s scared me enough that I felt I had to come in.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy lately?
No, I haven’t noticed feeling unusually high or full of energy.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?
Yes. Most days, I wake up with this heavy gray feeling before I even get out of bed. Sometimes I’ll tear up in the car before my shift just from seeing the casino lights.
Do the voices say things that fit with feeling guilty or worthless, like blaming you for bad things happening?

Yes. I keep going over every missed camera angle or call I was slow to make, like it proves I’m careless and dangerous. And... I feel like if something bad happens while I’m watching, maybe I deserve to be punished for it.
Do you believe anyone is trying to harm you or monitor you?
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed anyone specifically trying to harm me or monitor me.
Have the voices ever continued for at least two weeks during a time when you were not feeling depressed?
No. Before this low period after the lead change, I’d never heard those accusations or felt that sure I was dangerous. They’ve only happened along with feeling hopeless and guilty.
